usage.requestRule: Decode requestBytesBase64 directly, verify SHA, write bytes unchanged. Never reconstruct request bytes by JSON serialization.
usage.observationRule: rawObservationBytesBase64 is the complete actual archived capture including termination and diagnostics. Fresh diagnostic stacks may differ with checkout path; never rewrite the archived bytes to hide this.
usage.acceptanceRule: 12 real Python executions use native-basic-layered-v1, retain rawStrict differences, require exact public result plus independent geometry and input preservation. The Mapping case only requires explicit E04 admission rejection.

limitations: Project-authored regression inputs are not the complete upstream assertion set, a larger algorithm proof, a master denominator or a runtime dispatch table.
The exact external Java build remains unresolved; source identity here is the fixed generated elkjs artifact.
All archived captures actually report FakeWorker terminate TypeError; this is preserved evidence and is not worker/lifecycle success.
No production source fingerprints are frozen here. Run handoffs bind the actual implementation reviewed and executed in this iteration.
Geometry policies are authored independent input constraints; layout coordinates and section IDs are the real archived JS observations.
